name: Dragonborn armor
notes: Origin at the neck base, face +Z, wearer's left +X. Parts helmet, chest, back, shoulderL, shoulderR, gauntletL, gauntletR (pivots at neck base, sternum, between shoulder blades, shoulder joints, elbows; forearm along -Y). Joints eyes, rune, shout 0...1 switch follower options at 0.05; fur -1...1 is a hinge about Z on the cloak part.
parts: horned steel helm with brow band, nose guard, cheek guards and glowing eye slits
steel cuirass plates over a leather undersuit with belt and fur collar
fur-trimmed domed pauldrons with two hanging lames
vambraces with etched glowing runes and knuckle plates
leather cloak with fur lining and hem
style: Nordic steel armour with chamfered plates, rivets, curved horns, thick fur trim and cyan rune glow.
summary: Dragonborn Nordic armour kit: horned steel helm with glowing eye slits, fur-trimmed pauldrons, rune-etched gauntlets and a leather and fur cloak.
